title: rsp envelope (backend -> client)
description: The generic backend-to-client response frame. `data` is present on success, `error` on failure; both are permissive here because per-command data shapes are modelled in their own schemas (rsp-load-project, rsp-commit-group, rsp-metrics, dispatch-stats). This generic schema validates the OUTER contract that holds for every rsp regardless of command. NOTE: the subset cannot express 'data XOR error keyed on ok' (that needs if/then or oneOf, both banned) — so this schema asserts only the envelope invariants and leaves the ok/data/error correlation to the per-command schemas and to the consumer. That gap is a documented finding.
